```{r detection-gap-chart}

# ── Detection Gap Chart ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#
# This chart makes the core novelty argument of the project with real data.
#
# Part A — Calibration diagram:
# Shows that as the model's predicted probability rises, actual default
# rates rise in lockstep. This proves the model is capturing genuine risk.
# The shaded zones show where the Invisible Debt Trap Flag categories sit.
#
# Part B — Detection gap comparison:
# Compares two detection approaches on the same test set:
# 1. Traditional proxy: only flags customers already missing payments
#    (PAY_DELAY_COUNT >= 2 — equivalent to ASIC serious delinquency)
# 2. Our AI early warning: flags Watch and Early Flag customers who
#    have ZERO payment delays — the invisible stressed customers that
#    traditional monitoring completely misses
#
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────


# ── Step 1: Add PAY_DELAY_COUNT back into the mapped test set ─────────────────

test_flag_mapped$PAY_DELAY_COUNT <- test_data$PAY_DELAY_COUNT


# ── Step 2: Create 10 probability bands and calculate actual default rates ────

calibration_data <- test_flag_mapped %>%
  mutate(
    Prob_Band = cut(Default_Prob,
                   breaks = seq(0.25, 0.95, by = 0.07),
                   include.lowest = TRUE,
                   right          = FALSE)
  ) %>%
  group_by(Prob_Band) %>%
  summarise(
    Customers    = n(),
    Actual_Rate  = round(mean(Actual_Default == "Default") * 100, 1),
    Avg_Prob     = round(mean(Default_Prob) * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Prob_Band))

cat("Calibration data by probability band:\n")
print(calibration_data)
cat("\n")


# ── Step 3: Part A — Calibration reliability diagram ─────────────────────────

p_calibration <- ggplot(calibration_data,
                         aes(x = Avg_Prob, y = Actual_Rate)) +

  # Shaded zones
  annotate("rect", xmin = 25, xmax = 40,
           ymin = 0, ymax = 100,
           alpha = 0.07, fill = "#27AE60") +

  annotate("rect", xmin = 40, xmax = 62,
           ymin = 0, ymax = 100,
           alpha = 0.07, fill = "#F39C12") +

  annotate("rect", xmin = 62, xmax = 95,
           ymin = 0, ymax = 100,
           alpha = 0.08, fill = "#C0392B") +

  # Zone labels
  annotate("text", x = 33, y = 90,
           label = "Stable\nZone",
           size = 3, colour = "#27AE60", fontface = "bold") +

  annotate("text", x = 51, y = 90,
           label = "Early\nWarning\nZone",
           size = 3, colour = "#E67E22", fontface = "bold") +

  annotate("text", x = 78, y = 90,
           label = "High\nRisk\nZone",
           size = 3, colour = "#C0392B", fontface = "bold") +

  # Perfect calibration reference line
  geom_abline(slope     = 1,
              intercept = 0,
              linetype  = "dashed",
              colour    = "grey60",
              linewidth = 0.8) +

  # Actual calibration line
  geom_line(colour    = "#2C3E50",
            linewidth = 1.2) +

  geom_point(aes(size = Customers),
             colour = "#2C3E50",
             alpha  = 0.85) +

  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(Actual_Rate, "%")),
            vjust  = -1.2,
            size   = 3.2,
            colour = "#2C3E50",
            fontface = "bold") +

  scale_size_continuous(range = c(3, 9), guide = "none") +

  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(25, 95),
                     labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")) +

  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100),
                     labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")) +

  labs(
    title    = "Model Calibration — Predicted vs Actual Default Rate",
    subtitle = "Each point = one probability band | Point size = number of customers",
    x        = "Predicted Default Probability (%)",
    y        = "Actual Default Rate (%)",
    caption  = "Dashed line = perfect calibration"
  ) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "grey40", size = 9),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )


# ── Step 4: Part B — Detection gap comparison ─────────────────────────────────
#
# We compare two groups:
# Group 1 — Traditional proxy: PAY_DELAY_COUNT >= 2
#            These customers are already missing payments
#            Traditional monitoring catches them here
#
# Group 2 — AI early warning gap: Watch or Early Flag with zero delays
#            These customers show behavioural stress but no missed payments yet
#            Traditional monitoring completely misses these customers

traditional_group <- test_flag_mapped %>%
  filter(PAY_DELAY_COUNT >= 2)

ai_gap_group <- test_flag_mapped %>%
  filter(ML_Flag %in% c("Watch", "Early Flag"),
         PAY_DELAY_COUNT == 0)

comparison_data <- data.frame(
  Group        = c("Traditional Proxy\n(PAY_DELAY >= 2)",
                   "AI Early Warning Gap\n(Watch/Early Flag, no delays)"),
  Customers    = c(nrow(traditional_group), nrow(ai_gap_group)),
  Default_Rate = c(
    round(mean(traditional_group$Actual_Default == "Default") * 100, 1),
    round(mean(ai_gap_group$Actual_Default    == "Default") * 100, 1)
  ),
  Type = c("Traditional", "AI Gap")
)

cat("Detection gap comparison:\n")
print(comparison_data)
cat("\n")
cat("AI early warning gap customers — invisible to traditional systems:\n")
cat("Total customers our system catches early:", nrow(ai_gap_group), "\n")
cat("Their actual default rate:", comparison_data$Default_Rate[2], "%\n")
cat("Without our system these customers receive no warning\n\n")


p_gap <- ggplot(comparison_data,
                aes(x = Group, y = Customers, fill = Type)) +

  geom_bar(stat   = "identity",
           width  = 0.5,
           colour = "white") +

  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(comma(Customers),
                                "\ncustomers\n(",
                                Default_Rate, "% default)")),
            vjust    = -0.3,
            size     = 3.5,
            fontface = "bold") +

  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Traditional" = "#AEB6BF",
                                "AI Gap"      = "#2471A3")) +

  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma,
                     limits = c(0, max(comparison_data$Customers) * 1.35)) +

  labs(
    title    = "Detection Gap — What Traditional Systems Miss",
    subtitle = "Blue = customers our AI system catches before any payment delay occurs",
    x        = NULL,
    y        = "Number of Customers",
    caption  = "Traditional proxy = PAY_DELAY_COUNT >= 2 | AI gap = Watch/Early Flag with zero delays"
  ) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position    = "none",
    plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle      = element_text(colour = "grey40", size = 9),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank()
  )


# ── Step 5: Combine both charts ───────────────────────────────────────────────

grid.arrange(
  p_calibration, p_gap,
  ncol = 2,
  top  = grid::textGrob(
    "Invisible Debt Trap Analytics — Detection Gap Evidence",
    gp = grid::gpar(fontface = "bold", fontsize = 13)
  )
)
```
